responsibility: This is GCC’s master option-definition file for language-independent and driver/common switches. It declares many globally visible option state variables and describes the stable metadata for common command-line options—names, classes, aliases, negatives, enums, help text, and variable bindings—that the AWK generators turn into the option tables and option-state fields used by the driver and compiler proper for parsing, diagnostics, help output, and option propagation.
